odds_intro: Every pack has 3 cards. Cards 1 and 2 can be any rarity. Card 3 is always Legendary or better.
odds_fair: Fair play: you get a Limited if you haven't had one in {{top}} packs, and Holo or better if you haven't had one in {{holo}} packs. New cards come up more often than repeats.
odds_free_note: Packs can't be bought with money. Repeats turn into shards, and shards make any card you're missing.
